text: DSH File Viewer（DSH 插件，Web 客户端）：在 DSH 工作区内预览文件。它通过会话中的文件查看器面板读取本地文件或已注册内容提供方的数据，并按文件类型选择渲染方式。主要功能包括查看图片和 PDF、以表格浏览 CSV/TSV、预览 Markdown/JSON/YAML、阅读带语法高亮的源码，以及分块查看大文件。适合需要在对话界面检查生成文件或工作区资料的用户。使用本地文件浏览时可配置额外目录；无需额外 API 密钥。

DSH File Viewer previews workspace files inside the DSH web UI. It selects viewers for images, PDFs, CSV/TSV, Markdown, JSON, YAML, text, and source code. Large files load in chunks. Use it to inspect generated files beside a conversation; no API key is needed.

DSH File Viewer 的功能「图片与 PDF 预览」：按 MIME 和文件类型选择图片或 PDF 渲染器，在查看面板中预览内容。查看图片或 PDF 文件时自动触发。
DSH File Viewer 的功能「CSV 表格浏览」：CSV/TSV 内容可作为表格查看；解析器支持分隔符检测、引号字段和分块输入。打开 CSV/TSV 文件时解析并展示行列数据。
DSH File Viewer 的功能「文本与源码阅读」：普通文本和多种源码扩展名会进入文本或代码渲染路径，并可通过选项跳转到指定行。打开文本或源码文件；调用 openFile 时可传入行号。
DSH File Viewer 的功能「结构化文档预览」：Markdown、JSON/JSONL 与 YAML 由各自的专用渲染器处理，支持预览对应格式内容。打开相应扩展名文件时自动选择渲染器。
DSH File Viewer 的功能「大文件分块读取」：根据文件大小制定初始读取计划；中大型文件从有限字节开始读取，避免一次载入整个文件。预览大文件时按读取计划加载内容。

dsh-file-viewer README · DSH File Viewer：**Online:** [dsh.r2049.cn](https://dsh.r2049.cn) A universal, read-only file preview layer for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): open and inspect files right inside the web UI — no external application needed. > **Preview ≠ Execute.** The viewer is strictly read-only: previewing a file never > runs shell commands, scripts, macros, or HTML. SVG is rendered through ``, > and Markdown is sanitized before display.

dsh-file-viewer README · Supported file types：| Type | Renderer |
|---|---|
| PNG / JPG / GIF / WEBP / SVG / BMP | Image (fit, zoom, pan, dimensions) |
| PDF | PDF.js (page nav, page input, zoom, fit width/page) |
| CSV / TSV | Data table (delimiter auto-detect, sticky header, row numbers, search, sort, column resize, windowed rows, chunked loading) |
| TXT / LOG / OUT / INI / CONF | Text (line numbers, wrap, search, font size, chunk navigation) |
| JS / TS / Python / Go / Rust / Java / C/C++ / C# / Shell / HTML / CSS / SQL / … | Code (highlight.js, read-only) |
| Markdown | Preview (sanitized) + Source |
| JSON / JSONL | Tree (expand/collapse, copy value/path) + Source |
| YAML | Source + parsed Tree |
| anything else | Fallback (metadata + Open externally / Reveal / Copy path / optional Open as text) |

dsh-file-viewer README · How it works：- **Host half** (`dist/index.js`) registers the `/fileviewer` authenticated RPC
  channel and exposes both a `fileViewerContent` provider registry and a
  `fileViewerHost` bounded service for trusted transport plugins. The viewer does
  not assume content lives in a local folder: other host plugins can register
  readers for locators such as `artifact://run/report.json`, object storage,
  generated output, or remote APIs. A boundary-checked `ctx.fs` provider is
  installed only when that service is available; on the DSH v0.1.2+ package
  graph it discovers workspace roots from `ctx.workspaceRegistry`, live session
  cwd values from `ctx.sessions`, and native open support from
  `ctx.sessionController`.
- **Client half** (`dist/client.js`) provides the `fileViewer` service
  (`ctx.get('fileViewer')` → `openFile(path, { line, renderer })`) and renders
  the viewer as a `conversation.view` tab beside Chat and Trajectory. It opens
  from:
  - produced-file chips in the conversation (`conversation.chat.turnTail`,
    priority -1 — clicking an agent-generated file previews it in-app), or
  - the **"浏览文件 / Browse files"** entry added to each workspace

dsh-file-viewer README · Compatibility：`dsh-file-viewer` v0.3.4 and later support DSH v0.1.1-rc.2 plus the breaking
v0.1.2+ package graph, verified through `dsh-v0.1.5-rc.1`. On rc2 the host RPC
channel is registered with an explicit loopback authority and workspace
discovery uses the legacy `apiProxy` fallback. On v0.1.2+ the viewer
additionally uses `ctx.workspaceRegistry`, `ctx.sessions`, and
`ctx.sessionController`. The client metadata depends only on packages shared by
the supported graphs; their transitive dependencies provide the
generation-specific runtime services. On v0.1.2+ the viewer also accepts the
`conversation.view` focus request and treats its opaque focus value as a file
locator.

dsh-file-viewer README · Compatibility：DSH and React packages are host-provided optional peer dependencies for this
plugin. This is required by v0.1.2+ profiles, which keep peer auto-install
disabled (`autoInstallPeers: false`): installing the plugin must not add or
require a second copy of the in-box platform packages. Because npm semver does
not match later prereleases such as `0.1.5-rc.1` through
`>=0.1.2-alpha.1 <0.2.0`, the peer ranges explicitly include
`>=0.1.5-rc.1 <0.2.0`.

dsh-file-viewer README · Compatibility：The Workspace row Browse entry remains a compatibility patch because upstream
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace` has no third-party menu slot. Re-run
`scripts/patch-workspace-menu.mjs` after updating Harness; the script is

dsh-file-viewer README · Provide content from another host plugin：Trusted transport plugins can inject `fileViewerHost` and forward an explicit
allowlist of its endpoints. This is how `dsh-remote` previews files on a Remote
Host: access checks remain owned by the selected File Viewer content provider,
while the transport applies its own authentication, size limits, and method
allowlist. `openExternal` is intentionally not part of that remote surface.

text: dsh-file-viewer README · Security notes：- Path validation is enforced host-side on realpath'd targets against allowed roots (DSH v0.1.2+ workspace paths, live session cwd paths, the host cwd, and configured extra roots via `fs.contains`) by the optional local-files provider. Custom providers are responsible for authorization within their own locator namespace. - Markdown is rendered with `html: false` and sanitized with DOMPurify (scripts, iframes, event handlers and `javascript:` URLs removed). - SVG is never injected as HTML — it is displayed through ``. - Binary detection: NUL scan + magic bytes; "Open as text" is always an explicit user action. - Per-renderer error boundaries: a broken PDF/JSON can never crash the Harness UI.
